name: The Ashenvale Hunt
summary: In Ashenvale, the Horde's proven hunters face a new test beneath ancient trees. Jorn Skyseer sends you north from Camp Taurajo to Splintertree Post, where Senani Thunderheart awaits.

sections.title: Into the Ancient Canopy
sections.body: After proving yourself in the Barrens, you are sent toward Ashenvale. Jorn Skyseer sees when a hunter has outgrown the local game and points the way north. For the young Horde, these old forests offer resources and mark a political and spiritual frontier to understand and claim.

sections.title: Splintertree Post
sections.body: The road north passes the Mor'shan Rampart before reaching Splintertree Post, a fortified Horde camp deep among the trees. Senani Thunderheart, a tauren huntress, welcomes experienced hunters seeking harder tests of survival. The Horde needs skilled trackers to face Ashenvale's native predators and the forest's watchful defenders.

faq.q: Who sends me on the Ashenvale Hunt?
faq.answer: Jorn Skyseer, a tauren hunter at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens, sends you north after you prove your skill hunting local beasts.
Splintertree Post lies in east-central Ashenvale, along the north side of the road. Follow the main road north from the Barrens, past the Mor'shan Rampart and up through the woods.
Senani Thunderheart is a tauren huntress at Splintertree Post. She coordinates hunts across Ashenvale and teaches arriving Horde hunters to pursue the forest's fiercest predators and spirits.

faq.q: What other Horde outposts are nearby in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: The Horde also keeps the Warsong Lumber Camp to the east and Zoram'gar Outpost on the far western coast at the Zoram Strand.

faq.q: Why is the Horde interested in hunting in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: Ashenvale's wilds offer meat, pelts, and resources scarce in arid Durotar and the Barrens. Facing its dangerous beasts also tests the will and spiritual strength of Horde hunters and warriors.
Senani Thunderheart sends experienced hunters to track woodland threats beneath the canopy, including the great bear Ursangous, the cat Shadumbra, and the hippogryph Sharptalon.

angles.text: As a hunter, you leave Kalimdor's plains for Ashenvale's dense canopy, where exotic beasts await tracking, study, and taming.
As a tauren, you follow the guidance of Jorn Skyseer and Senani Thunderheart. They see the hunt as a spiritual balance and a way to honor the wilderness.
As a member of the Horde, you enter a strategic frontier. A foothold in Ashenvale brings timber and food to settlements across Durotar and the Barrens.
